white_border_comparison.summary: The white lower edge is generated within the image, not added by a post-processing node. Repeated generic four-view prompts retained it across seeds; renaming Character Sheet and adding no-border wording did not remove it. Removing face close-up removed the face panel and introduced a duplicated front, so it is not a valid clean fix. The earlier descriptive three-view prompt placed the face view to the canvas bottom and showed no lower edge at the same source and resolution. Two four-view prompts that explicitly asked the face panel to reach the canvas bottom still retained the edge. Evidence points to a learned four-panel inset layout interacting with prompt/layout phrasing; it is not attributable to the words face close-up alone.
